items.title: The key takeaways from six days of evidence at NDIS Senate inquiry
items.description: A Senate inquiry into the proposed NDIS shake-up was told the government must stamp out rorting, while avoiding cuts that could put participants in unsafe environments and cause carers to burn out. Here are the key takeaways from the six days of hearings.

items.title: Man says he was 'very scared' during alleged Alan Jones bedroom assault
items.description: A man accusing Alan Jones of historical indecent assault has told a court he followed the broadcaster's alleged direction to have a shower and come out in a robe because he did not want to disappoint Mr Jones.

items.title: Imam calls out pro-Palestine rally comments as 'inappropriate'
items.description: A prominent Australian imam has said comments made at a pro-Palestinian rally at which another imam described October 7, 2023 as a "day of pride" and "victory" were inappropriate.

items.title: Breaking: Fatalities reported at school shooting in Thailand
items.description: Thai police say there have been fatalities at a school shooting in Thailand north of the capital, Bangkok.

items.title: Live: Toddler was rescued by police from scene of suspected murder-suicide
items.description: Murweh Shire Mayor Shaun Radnedge says the community will band together despite the devastating "violent" crime that has left a woman and a man dead.

items.title: 'Extraordinary' Antarctic medevac performed in extreme -43C conditions
items.description: The temperature on the icy continent was a frosty -43 degrees Celsius when an Australian crew evacuated a polar expeditioner after an "urgent request for assistance".

items.title: Commonwealth's PFAS case against 3M 'daunting', judge says
items.description: A $2 billion lawsuit for defence base contamination against the US chemical manufacturer is heard in court for the first time.

items.title: First images show Moon's fresh crater after stray rocket impact
items.description: A satellite has captured the first pictures of the Moon's fresh crash scene caused by a stray SpaceX rocket, showing noticeably darker terrain.

items.title: Battle for Victoria sends signals to Canberra
items.description: Victoria's election on November 28 has taken on a drama and significance we wouldn't have anticipated a year ago.

items.title: Australian councils swap grass for native wildflower meadows
items.description: You may have spotted more native plants popping up in your local park or on the side of the road. It's part of a push to create hardier, more beautiful council plantings across Australia.

items.title: Youths charged over alleged fatal attack of Melbourne shop owner bailed
items.description: A 12-year-old boy and two 14-year-old girls are granted bail after being charged with a number of offences including affray and intentionally causing serious injury, while a 15-year-old charged with manslaughter remains in custody.

items.title: Even with new tech, experts say US is 'poorly prepared' to de-mine strait
items.description: Even with a range of high-tech equipment such as underwater drones and helicopter-mounted lasers, clearing the Strait of Hormuz of Iranian sea mine threats will be a painstaking and challenging process.

items.title: How Australians on JobSeeker are living on $68 a day
items.description: Despite calls to increase the base rate of JobSeeker payments in this year's federal budget, there has been no change and experts say it means the cost of living is hurting those who can least afford it.

items.title: Police chief reflects on TV interview by grandmother of missing boy Gus
items.description: SA's police chief says the actions of officers leading up to last week's murder-suicide will be investigated as detectives continue to consider "further search opportunities" for missing four-year-old Gus Lamont.

items.title: The affordable fresh fruit and veggies to shop for this month
items.description: From baby broccoli to gai lan, these are the vegetables (and fruit) to look for this month.

items.title: What happens when the world's largest online retail warehouse moves to town
items.description: Burra Creek is the home of the world's largest online retail warehouse. It's also the setting for a moving new production about the struggles faced by everyday Australian families.

items.title: Friday news quiz: A bored prince, Jetstar's new fee and a stunning view of … something
items.description: Please ensure your seat is upright and, if you can still afford it, stow your bag in the overhead compartment: this quiz is ready for take-off.

items.title: Finnish judge impressed by Australia's best golden retrievers
items.description: Nearly 300 golden retrievers have taken over a small town in South Australia's Barossa Valley for a national competition.

items.title: Men's behaviour change groups could soon face new rules
items.description: Programs range from one day sessions in schools educating boys on respectful relationships to months-long programs working with men who have abused their partners and children.

items.title: 'I panicked': Developer tried to end affordable housing early
items.description: A property developer that describes itself as a leader in the national push to build cheap homes has been trying to scale back affordable housing at some of its projects.

items.title: 'No money left': Man stole $220k in three months to fund online bets
items.description: The Supreme Court in Hobart has heard online gambling has been "the primary cause of problems" in the man's life. He'll spend six months in prison after pleading guilty to 20 charges relating to the theft from Salmon Tasmania.

items.title: NRL and AFL 'saturated' with gambling and alcohol sponsors, report finds
items.description: Every NRL and AFL club has an alcohol sponsor this season while every NRL and five AFL clubs are sponsored by gambling companies, a new report has found.

items.title: Meta ordered to pay $806m to address 'public nuisance' and child harm claims
items.description: A court in the US state of New Mexico has ordered Instagram and Facebook parent company Meta to pay $806 million to address harms to young people from its platforms.

items.title: Live: ASX down as economists expect RBA to hold cash rate
items.description: The Australian market has edged down, with the Industrials sector the biggest laggard. And a poll of 37 of Australia's leading economists found all expect the RBA to leave its key cash rate unchanged after its meeting on Tuesday. Follow live.

items.title: Council decides to sell off parts of farm donated 'in good faith' to community
items.description: Boyup Brook locals say they were blindsided by the shire's decision to wind down a beloved farm donated to the community more than four decades ago.
